audience: legal and operations teams that draft, track and update contracts in Pocketlaw

useCases.title: Find contracts and their signing status
useCases.text: List documents with their status and sign status. Search documents by an id from your own system.

useCases.title: Browse templates before drafting
useCases.text: List the contract templates with their categories and locales. Read one template with its fields and rules.

useCases.title: Create a draft from a template
useCases.text: Create a document from a template with its field values. It creates a record only, and nothing is sent for signature.

useCases.title: Update the fields of a document
useCases.text: Change the name, field values or external metadata of one document. Only the fields you pass change.

useCases.title: Browse the folders of the account
useCases.text: List document folders with their parent ids, or search folders by name or parent id.
